summary: Enter exact food values from a label and track nutrients such as fiber, net carbs and added sugar without an AI guess replacing the numbers.

evidence.claim: 10 dated complaints about inexact manual entry and missing nutrients across 4 apps
evidence.source: state/scout/2026-11-17-health-fitness.json (c5; each quote has an Apple review RSS URL and date)

scores.note: nutrition is crowded (MyFitnessPal, Cronometer); spec must name a real capability difference. Avoid medical claims
